workIntro.eyebrow: A CLOSER LOOK AT OUR WORK
workIntro.heading: In every yard,
workIntro.paragraph: A fresh first impression. A more inviting backyard. Details that bring it all together. Take a closer look at the difference thoughtful care can make.

beforeAfter.eyebrow: A LITTLE BEFORE. A BEAUTIFUL AFTER.

beforeAfter.paragraph: Every transformation has a starting point. See both sides of the story, from overgrown beds to fresh mulch, clean borders, and new planting.
beforeAfter.paragraph2: Open any comparison to see both full photos.

gallery.heading: Good things grow.
gallery.paragraph: Fresh stripes, welcoming gardens, and the work along the way. Explore the full collection, from the first steps to the finishing touches.
gallery.paragraph2: Every photo has a story. Tap one for a closer look.

videos.heading: Our work.
videos.paragraph: Fresh cuts, seasonal changes, and a closer look around. Short videos from the spaces we care for, throughout the year.
